subject.title: Control UI chat markdown only renders data URI images, not remote https image URLs

question: Should Control UI render remote http/https Markdown image URLs from chat content, and if so should that be direct browser fetch, proxy-mediated, or operator opt-in?
rationale: Current code, tests, docs, and merged hardening intentionally prevent remote browser image fetches, while the request improves UX by changing that security boundary.

options.title: Keep no-remote-fetch default
options.body: Preserve same-origin, data, and blob image rendering until an explicit proxy or opt-in design is approved.

options.title: Approve direct remote images
options.body: Accept the privacy/read-receipt tradeoff and require coordinated renderer, CSP, docs, tests, and browser proof updates.

options.title: Design mediated media path
options.body: Treat remote images as structured media that can be proxied, consent-gated, or opened explicitly rather than fetched silently on render.

recommendation.title: Keep no-remote-fetch default
recommendation.body: Preserve same-origin, data, and blob image rendering until an explicit proxy or opt-in design is approved.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved choice is closest to the Control UI browser-fetch and CSP policy area touched by drobison00's merged hardening work.
